_doc: This file is ONLY for providers that need bespoke free-model discovery logic.
Every provider NOT listed here is handled generically at runtime:
- credentials & baseUrl are read from the 9router SQLite providerConnections table
- free models are discovered by calling GET /v1/models with the stored API key
Add an entry here ONLY when a provider needs one of:
- A non-standard API format (e.g. Gemini, Cloudflare)
- Filtering to find which models are free (e.g. OpenRouter :free suffix)
- Special credential resolution (e.g. Kilo access-token, Cloudflare account-id+token)
- Web scraping or a static model list (e.g. OpenAgentic, OpenCode)
- Custom base URL that is NOT stored in SQLite (e.g. OpenCode's hardcoded list)
Fields:
key            Unique key; must match the adapter name in PROVIDER_DISCOVERY_MAP in providers.js
connection     SQLite providerConnections provider name to look up credentials (optional)
credentialKind scan | kilo | bai | cloudflare | default (default = read apiKey from connection data)
baseUrl        Override base URL when not stored in SQLite (optional)
modelsUrl      Override URL for fetching the models list (optional)
matchHosts     For credentialKind=scan: hostname substrings to match against stored baseUrls
solo           If true, do not run this provider concurrently with others (rate-limit sensitive)
throttleMs     Min ms between requests (optional)
freeOnly       Paid-model guard: if true, only :free / -free models accepted from this provider.
Used by isPaidModel(). Does NOT affect discovery — only the paid-model filter.
Set this for providers whose catalog mixes paid+free and needs filtering.
